title: Returned Payment Fee and Payment-Method Restriction Values for the Electric Service Agreement
content:
When a payment toward an Electric Service Agreement is returned unpaid by the customer's bank, the schedule's returned payment fee is posted. Repeated returns within the look-back lead to a refusal of check and bank-draft payments.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Returned payment fee | The fee posted when a payment is returned unpaid by the customer's bank, in USD. |
| Restriction count | The number of returned payments within the restriction look-back after which check and bank-draft payments are refused. |
| Restriction months | The length of both the returned-payment look-back and the resulting check and bank-draft refusal, in months. |

Columns: RS is Schedule RS Residential Standard Service, RT is Schedule RT Residential Time-of-Use Service, REV is Schedule REV Residential Electric Vehicle Time-of-Use Service, GS is Schedule GS Small General Service, GST is Schedule GST Small General Time-of-Use Service, GD is Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service and LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

| Term | RS | RT | REV | GS | GST | GD | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Returned payment fee, USD | 20.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 30.00 | 35.00 |
| Returned payments that trigger the check and bank-draft refusal | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Look-back and refusal length, months | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |

The fee is 20.00 USD on the residential schedules, 25.00 USD on GS and GST, 30.00 USD on GD and 35.00 USD on LP. On every schedule the restriction count is 2 and the look-back and refusal each run 12 months.

Hypothetical illustration: on a Schedule GD agreement, a first returned payment posts a 30.00 USD fee; a second return within the 12-month look-back brings the count to 2, the restriction count of that schedule, and the refusal then runs for 12 months.
